title: model-eol feed-refresh receipt
description: Feed-refresh receipt `model-eol/feed-refresh-receipt@0.1` written by every successful feed-refresh run. It binds the refresh run URL (refresh_run), the commit the run checked (refresh_commit), and the check time (checked_at) to the SHA-256 of every feeds/*.json file the run produced. A clean receipt means the live sources matched those feeds; a pending receipt means the run opened or updated pending_pr with material changes. The public contract is published only when a receipt's digests match the exact feeds being published. Compatibility: additive changes keep this version; any change that makes an existing receipt invalid or changes what a digest covers is a new version, and validators reject unknown versions. Enforced in code, not by this schema: feeds must be sorted by path (String.prototype.localeCompare), no two feeds may share a path, and URLs are checked by WHATWG URL parsing (this schema accepts only the normalized https://host form the writer emits).
